verdict.rationale: Box's developer homepage claims you can 'embed a secure, expiring preview of files stored in Box' with in-context annotation. That covers the embeddable-preview half of the story, but only as a single marketing-level mention with no API reference or guide detail. Shared links give read-only URL access, which is an adjacent capability and not a rendered preview service, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: any evidence of a thumbnail/representation API, documented preview endpoints or embed mechanics, a list of supported formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
